description: Focused repair PRD for the current pull-request CI failure on the Ralph self-iteration integration branch.

userStories.title: Repair MCP Resource Comment Lint Failure
userStories.story: As a Weave maintainer, I want the MCP resource subscription code to satisfy the US-English lint gate so the pull-request CI can continue through the Go test, coverage, contract, and vulnerability stages.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the current pull-request CI failure, when golangci-lint checks pkg/mcp/resources.go, then it no longer reports misspell for the resource subscription comment.
Given the prior MCP resource subscription behavior, when pkg/mcp tests run, then subscribe, unsubscribe, read, and list behavior continue to pass.
Given the Ralph loop state, when the repair is verified, then this story is marked passes=true and progress records the CI evidence and verification commands.
